column1: # ESP32-SIP-Voice partition table with OTA support (16 MB flash).
# Two OTA app slots (A/B) plus the otadata selector make over-the-air updates
# and automatic rollback possible. ota_0 is where the first serial flash lands;
# an update is written to the inactive slot and only replaces it after the new
# image boots and confirms it is healthy.

column2: shrink ota_0/ota_1 to 0x180000 and drop the spare tail.
